segments.name: Sterigenics
segments.description: Provides outsourced terminal sterilization and irradiation services using gamma, EO and E-beam technologies for medical device, pharmaceutical and food safety customers.
segments.evidence: Sterigenics provides outsourced terminal sterilization and irradiation services for the medical device, pharmaceutical, food safety and advanced applications markets using three major technologies: gamma irradiation, EO processing and E-beam irradiation.

segments.name: Nordion
segments.description: Supplies radioactive cobalt sources, gamma irradiation systems and related lifecycle services to medical device, pharmaceutical, food safety and cancer treatment customers.
segments.evidence: Nordion is a leading global provider of Co-60 used in the sterilization and irradiation processes for the medical device, pharmaceutical, food safety, and high-performance materials industries, as well as in the treatment of cancer.

segments.name: Nelson Labs
products: microbiological and analytical chemistry testing and advisory services
segments.description: Provides outsourced microbiological and analytical chemistry testing and advisory services to medical device and pharmaceutical companies.
segments.evidence: Nelson Labs provides outsourced microbiological and analytical chemistry testing and advisory services for the medical device and pharmaceutical industries.

revenueModel.text: Medical device, pharmaceutical and food customers pay for contract sterilization, lab testing and advisory services, and for gamma irradiation systems and sources.
revenueModel.evidence: Service revenues primarily consist of revenue generated from contract sterilization and lab testing and advisory services within our Sterigenics and Nelson Labs segments, respectively.
